name: Project Nightfall

features.text: UV-sensitive infected types, sun damage, hibernation, shelter/evasion and Feral reserve/sprinting.
Smart stalking/ambush, screech response, personal hordes and persistent Alpha leadership/territory.
Seasonal movement, shelters/dens, lighting defense and bounded crowd behavior.
Provenance-checked body-part effigies and feeding; research files and configurable presets.

Read-only effigy container policy classifies five source categories, rejects incompatible batches/bags/invalid provenance and derives the three visual identifiers from physical contents. No transfers or world renderer enabled.
Reusable world container, native transfer/feed/save integration and EMPTY/MEAT_LOADED/BODY_PART_LOADED assets remain planned; preserve source separation and no meat/part mixing.

Native queued transfers validate category before enqueue but not at inspected commit; live binding stops until a safe Lua-only server transfer/lease boundary and rendering/save contracts are verified.
Server-authoritative UV infected policy using MORTIS services: starvation-gated Feral/Smart/Alpha lifecycles, hibernation/rise, bounded regional tissue work and intelligent groups/ecology.
Transactional effigy food provider with reserve/commit/rollback and post-success world cleanup; native persistence and transport remain unverified.
Own-owner cleanup before identity/phase commit, retryable UV release, checked assignment compensation and a retained server recovery journal. Unknown outcomes remain blocked for review.
Dependency diagnostics separate API surface from source capability readiness. MORTIS API 1.6/food transaction v1 required; Knowledge 0.16.0 affected MP storage remains blocked.
Read-only localized selected-corpse remains-condition UI; sandbox/presets, research content and bounded diagnostics. SPXTRM retains the lightWorks Lua namespace.
Native smoke/anatomical presentation and loot-preserving visible remains after safe adapters, plus human balance/audio validation.
Human SP/dedicated lifecycle, owner/restoration, observer/late join and save/restart acceptance. Native packaging/release gates remain separate; no runtime proof from CI.

limits: Development 0.31.0-dev.1 source/offline foundation only. Existing legacy effigies remain active.
